global_delta: Converge on executable realization of the existing G9 semantic basis. Highest-information BASE slice: compile/run LoopDynamicsReadout plus Safe-Effect child-capability closure on Ubuntu before further semantic redesign.

clayresearch.delta: The smallest coherent cross-mesh controller basis is now a typed local LoopDynamicsReadout family plus shared budget/authority/epoch arbitration, not one global emergence or stability scalar.
clayresearch.next_test: Re-fuse only after executable BASE probes or live Harness evidence changes this basis.

frank.delta: Preserve Frank as a multiscale loop-of-loops hypothesis, but avoid wiring a fixed recurrent gain. High-volatility synthetic counterevidence requires innovation/volatility-aware recurrence control.
frank.next_test: Provide exact frozen loop/state/update requirements to ClayCode; later H1 replay compares fixed vs adaptive recurrence.

gwt.delta: Test ignition/focus as adaptive compute routing rather than unconditional recurrence. Truthful re-entry can help, but fixed gain can become harmful under volatile dynamics.
gwt.next_test: Matched truthful/shuffled/no-reentry episodes with fixed-depth versus innovation/marginal-utility-gated continuation.

emergenz.delta: PEID is a promising intervention-defined higher-order causal readout, but remains supplementary to lesion/rescue/shuffle and pairwise/macro controls. Recurrence is not emergence.
emergenz.next_test: Apply PEID only to preregistered intervention variables/scales after H1 exposes deterministic replay handles.

claycode.delta: No new primitive is currently justified. Existing records/rules/cycles, CapabilityToken, EffectIntent, hyperrelations, GWT axes and IncrementalReceipt should be compiled first.
claycode.next_test: Parser -> canonical IR -> type/effect -> evaluator/runtime for minimal LoopDynamicsReadout and nested child-capability program on Ubuntu.

hyperposition.delta: Preserve role-bearing n-ary identity and unresolved alternatives. Reopening should be stall/residual-pressure gated and bounded, not novelty-only.
hyperposition.next_test: Compare stalled-episode recovery with bounded branch reopening versus no reopening and novelty-only reopening.

claygraph.delta: Keep current topology derived and epoch-bound. Favor dependency-local incremental projection where measured locality exists; permit selective rebuild when retained differential state is expensive.
claygraph.next_test: Measure real H1/BASE dependency fan-out and stale-edge behavior; do not extrapolate the 0.156% synthetic closure result.

unifieddb.delta: Leading persistence hypothesis remains canonical event/history spine plus logically unified identity/query semantics and rebuildable derived views, not forced physical monolith.
unifieddb.next_test: Define epoch-consistent incremental view/replay contracts needed by BASE without prematurely performing the UDB stage.

harness.delta: Do not mark H1 work complete before BASE. Prepare future tests for loop volatility/adaptive re-entry, child-effect closure, terminal sinks, n-ary role preservation and incremental dependency locality.
harness.next_test: After BASE PASS, execute these on frozen H1 episodes and preserve lesion/rescue/recovery receipts.

negative_results_preserved: Fixed truthful re-entry gain is not monotonically beneficial; high process volatility can make it worse than no re-entry.
Naive unordered pairwise projection cannot preserve n-ary role permutations, but reified pairwise encoding remains a viable simpler alternative.
Incremental-locality speed result is topology-dependent and cannot be promoted from the favorable synthetic graph.
